---
title: "Delta Fish Monitoring"
format:
  dashboard:
    theme: flatly
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(contentid)
library(plotly)
library(DT)

sha1 <- "hash://sha1/317d7f840e598f5f3be732ab0e04f00a8051c6d0"
delta_file <- contentid::resolve(sha1, registries = c("dataone"), store = TRUE)

delta_data <- read.csv(delta_file) |>
  mutate(SampleDate = mdy(SampleDate)) |>
  filter(grepl("Salmon|Striped Bass|Smelt|Sturgeon", CommonName))
```

# Summary

## Row {height="25%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Species Monitored"
list(
    icon = "binoculars",
    color = "primary",
    value = n_distinct(delta_data$CommonName)
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Years of Data"
list(
    icon = "calendar3",
    color = "success",
    value = n_distinct(year(delta_data$SampleDate))
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total Observations"
list(
    icon = "table",
    color = "info",
    value = nrow(delta_data))
```

## Row {height="75%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Water Clarity Over Time"
p <- delta_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = SampleDate, y = Secchi)) +
  geom_point(color = "#2C7BB6", alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Secchi depth (m)") +
  theme_light()

ggplotly(p)
```

```{r}
#| title: "Catch by Species"
delta_data |>
  group_by(CommonName) |>
  summarize(
    Observations = n(),
    `Total Catch` = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Avg Secchi (m)` = round(mean(Secchi, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  ) |>
 DT::datatable(rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 5))
```

# Catch Trends

## Row {.tabset}

```{r}
#| title: "Annual Catch by Species"
annual_catch <- delta_data |>
  mutate(Year = year(SampleDate)) |>
  group_by(Year, CommonName) |>
  summarize(total_catch = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

p2 <- ggplot(annual_catch, aes(x = Year, y = total_catch, color = CommonName)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Total Catch", color = "Species") +
  theme_light()

ggplotly(p2)
```


```{r}
#| title: "Raw Data"
delta_data |>
  select(SampleDate, CommonName, Count, Secchi) |>
  datatable(rownames = FALSE)
```
